look_here_first: Look for an aggressively rhizomatous, hairy perennial with small white-to-pink gaura flowers and mature fruits conspicuously swollen or bulging on the upper half.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: fruit with conspicuously swollen upper portion

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: mature fruit is critical for separation from O. suffrutescens

lookalikes.differences: O. hispida can resemble O. suffrutescens strongly. Use mature capsules: O. hispida has distinctly expanded upper fruit lobes, whereas O. suffrutescens has a thick stipe and less abruptly swollen fruit.
